financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Convertible notes offering (Indenture and Notes), net proceeds after initial purchasers' discounts and expenses. The date is the 8-K filing date, since the excerpt gives no explicit closing date.
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The net proceeds from this offering were approximately $333.9 million, after deducting the Initial Purchasers’ discounts and commissions and the Company’s estimated offering expenses related to the offering.
